features.name: Airyscan mode
features.line: Airyscan mode and processing are chosen per track in ZEN; the file records the mode per channel.
features.seenInFiles: 1 of 2 LSM 980 .czi files: Airyscan, mode FastAiryScanSheppardSum on all 4 channels; the other is plain confocal (tiled). ZEN records System 'LSM 800' for both.
